findings.title: Elite/boss intro hitch returns after first ~90 frames on mid-phone
findings.detail: After Perf.frames>=90 and tier 0, spawnLite=false, particles=26, freezeT=0.1s. Wave 2+ on a still-smooth mid-phone dumps full intro + freeze.

findings.title: Colossal / super-boss intro still 100ms+ freeze when spawnLite is off
juiceKillSnap freeze is not gated by liteFx / spawnLite
findings.detail: Lite FX still applies freezeT 0.058s (common) / 0.075s (elite) on every kill before the shake rate-limit.

findings.title: applyHitStop ignore liteFx — punch/kick freeze stays on mid-phone
findings.detail: punch=0.034s heavy=0.072s litePunch=0.034s. Only motionReduced skips it.

findings.title: Mid-phone after opener is full-fat FX until EMA climbs to tier 1/2
findings.detail: fxLite() is liteFx OR tier>=2 OR reduced-motion. After 90 frames at tier 0, neither spawnLite nor fxLite is on — death bursts, crit rings, hit-stop are desktop-weight.

findings.title: Long session: pool + scenery stay bounded; UI canvases are the leftover leak risk
findings.detail: 24 startGame cycles: maxPool=27 endPool=48 maxParticles=21 maxScenery=2. Particle pool recycles. SceneryArt evicts. UI.js still news 64px canvases on each upgrades/pets/gear paint.
